## 🎨 UX & Accessibility Checklist

Please ensure your PR follows these standards:

- [ ] **ARIA Labels:** Icon-only buttons and interactive elements have descriptive `aria-label` attributes.
- [ ] **Semantic HTML:** Used semantic elements (`<button>`, `<label>`, `<nav>`, etc.) instead of generic `<div>` or `<span>` for interactive parts.
- [ ] **Keyboard Navigation:** All interactive elements are reachable via Tab and have visible focus states.
- [ ] **Color Contrast:** Text and interactive elements meet WCAG AA contrast standards.
- [ ] **Bilingual Support:** New Bengali text uses the `lang="bn"` attribute for correct screen reader pronunciation.
- [ ] **Form Labels:** Every input has an associated `<label>` (either via `htmlFor` or nesting).

## 🧪 Testing

- [ ] Tested with keyboard-only navigation.
- [ ] (Optional) Verified with a screen reader.
- [ ] All existing tests pass.
